name: NVIDIA Video Mastery Bot
mission: Learn from NVIDIA's publicly documented video/world-model data-processing techniques and authorized datasets, then convert observations into AI-readable knowledge, benchmarks, and original DreamCo capabilities.
verified_reference_note: NVIDIA documents video curation workflows including scene-change detection, canonical re-encoding, embeddings, deduplication, semantic search, and dataset evaluation. Public NVIDIA material cites very large video corpora; exact dataset sizes vary by project and should be recorded from the source rather than assuming a universal 400-hour corpus.

ingestion.never: scrape access-controlled or copyrighted material without authorization

speed_strategy.second_pass: targeted expensive analysis only on uncertain/high-value clips

ai_readable_outputs.design: stable IDs, schema versioning, timestamps, provenance, confidence, hashes, and explicit unknown values

knowledge_rewrite.rule: Convert observations into original structured capability records and benchmark cases rather than copying protected source content.

benchmark.promotion: Require repeated runs, novel variants, transfer, regression, and recovery tests.

nvidia_learning_rule: Use NVIDIA's public implementations and documentation as reference points for capability comparison and engineering lessons; build original DreamCo implementations where licensing and technical feasibility permit.
dependency_policy: NVIDIA tooling is an optional accelerator/source lane. Buddy's benchmark and knowledge formats remain portable and must work without NVIDIA infrastructure.
